rule fiba-3pt (FIBA): The three-point arc has a radius of 6.75 m.
rule fiba-ft-line (FIBA): The free-throw line's furthest edge is 5.80 m from the inner edge of the endline.
rule fiba-quarters (FIBA): A game is 4 quarters of 10 minutes.
rule fiba-overtime (FIBA): Overtimes are 5 minutes, as many as needed to break the tie.
rule fiba-shot-clock (FIBA): A team must attempt a shot within 24 seconds.

rule fiba-14 (FIBA): The shot clock resets to 14 seconds in set frontcourt situations (e.g. a frontcourt throw-in after a foul or violation, or the same team regaining control after the ball touches the ring).
rule fiba-8s (FIBA): The ball must be brought into the frontcourt within 8 seconds.
rule fiba-3s (FIBA): Three-second rule exists (Article 26).
rule fiba-5s-guarded (FIBA): A closely guarded player must pass, shoot or dribble within 5 seconds.
rule fiba-5s-throwin (FIBA): A throw-in must be released within 5 seconds.
rule fiba-5-fouls (FIBA): A player with 5 fouls must leave the game.
rule fiba-team-fouls (FIBA): A team is in the team foul penalty after 4 team fouls in a quarter (so the 5th brings free throws); overtime fouls count with the 4th quarter.
rule fiba-same-foot (FIBA): After ending a dribble a player may not touch the court consecutively with the same foot or both feet.
rule fiba-injury-15 (FIBA): An injured player who cannot continue immediately (within approximately 15 seconds) must be substituted.

rule fiba-no-charge (FIBA): The no-charge semi-circle is 1.30 m from the point under the centre of the basket to its OUTER edge (2026 text); the older wording '1.25 m' measured to the inner edge of a 5 cm line describes the same line.
rule nba-3pt (NBA): NBA arc 23 ft 9 in from the middle of the basket, with lines 3 ft from the sidelines in the corners.
rule nba-restricted (NBA): The NBA restricted area is a half-circle 4 ft from the centre of the basket ring.
rule nba-quarters (NBA): NBA periods are twelve minutes; overtimes five minutes.
rule nba-14 (NBA): The NBA shot clock resets to 14 seconds in set situations.
rule nba-6-fouls (NBA): An NBA player is disqualified on the sixth personal foul.
rule nba-ot-penalty (NBA): In NBA overtime, common team fouls in excess of three are penalised with free throws.
rule nba-5s-back (NBA): Below the free-throw line extended an offensive player may not dribble with back or side to the basket for more than five seconds.
rule nba-def-3s (NBA): The NBA has a defensive three-second rule.
rule youth-max-hours (NBA/USA Basketball youth guidelines): Maximum organised basketball per week: 3 h (7-8), 5 h (9-11), 10 h (12-14), 14 h (grades 9-12).
rule youth-rest (NBA/USA Basketball youth guidelines): Minimum rest days per week: 2 (7-8), 2 (9-11), 1 (12-14), 1 (grades 9-12).
rule youth-specialise (NBA/USA Basketball youth guidelines): Delay specialisation in basketball until at least age 14.
rule youth-practice-7-8 (NBA/USA Basketball youth guidelines): Ages 7-8: 1 practice a week of 30-60 minutes recommended.
